status: post-review exploratory supplements; original primary results retained

non_concept_controls.PCA: fit on allowed F or T embeddings only; H/E excluded; shared coordinate system within each head fit
non_concept_controls.projection: fixed orthonormal Gaussian directions; all seeds reported, no best-seed selection
non_concept_controls.scaling: training-only coordinate standardization for PCA, random, and matched soft-score control
non_concept_controls.selection: six original C values, mean of four inner-H class-equal NLLs; smallest C on ties

L1.selection: four inner-H validation losses; no outer or external selection

CBIS_repeat.upstream: full nested refit, fixed probe C=1, minimum state support=10; no reuse of old OOF predictions
CBIS_repeat.heads: original raw-score M and four-coefficient Cflex; full-chain reference-head exclusion
CBIS_repeat.failure: report a fixed-support failure; do not change support or seed

learning_curve.scope: diagnostic-head training size only; archived nested upstream panels fixed
learning_curve.subset: nested random patient subsets within each F/T, H/E unchanged; both heads use the same subset

PH2.scope: primary 25-model mean probabilities; class-specific distance associations and exact ranking-pair changes; no label-based fitting
PH2.distance: Ledoit-Wolf on 609 source OOF mean score vectors, 12 free coordinates
PH2.decomposition: mean per-model M minus reference logit; not a decomposition of the nonlinear Cflex probability

inference.unit: patients for CBIS, cases for Derm/PH2; same draw across arms and repetitions
inference.scope: conditional on fitted models; exploratory intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted

stop: one execution of these recipes; null or unfavorable outcomes retained; no outcome-dependent extension
